# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Aug 20, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on porting core `op-node` components to Rust, refining interop mechanisms, and enhancing documentation. Key achievements include the Rust port of `kona-safedb` and significant updates to developer workflow and security review documentation.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Infrastructure & Interoperability Enhancements
*   **Rust Port of `op-node`'s SafeDB:** The `kona-safedb` crate has been introduced, providing a 1-to-1 Rust port of the `op-node`'s `safedb` package. This is crucial for systems requiring a high-fidelity record of L2 safe heads per L1 block, such as fault proofs and interop. ([#21522](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21522))
*   **Refinement of Cross-Unsafe Chain-Head Notion:** The vestigial cross-unsafe chain-head concept, inherited from the `op-supervisor` era, has been removed from Go-side components (`op-node`, `op-service`, `op-devstack`). This streamlines the codebase by eliminating a notion no longer relevant to current interop designs. ([#22555](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22555))
*   **Kona Engine Pipeline Reset Logic:** The `kona-node` now consistently resets the engine upon a pipeline reset, removing a suppression that previously occurred when interop was active. This ensures proper state synchronization after events like L1 reorgs. ([#22551](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22551))
*   **Configurable AltDA Input Size Limit:** The `op-alt-da` component now allows for a configurable input-size limit, providing operators with more control over Keccak derivation and batcher validation. ([#22496](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22496))

### Developer Experience & Documentation Improvements
*   **Enhanced Developer Workflow Documentation:** New guidelines have been added to `AGENTS.md`, requiring developers to watch CI after pushing to a PR and to run local review agents before opening a PR. This aims to improve code quality and reduce CI failures. ([#22574](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22574), [#22572](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22572))
*   **Security Review Publication:** The final security review report for Upgrade 20 (Cantina) has been added to the documentation, providing transparency on protocol security. ([#22559](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22559))
*   **Updated Release Documentation:** Release history pages for `op-reth` (v2.4.2) and `op-contracts` (v8.0.0-rc.3) have been updated to reflect the latest versions. ([#22564](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22564))

### Fault Proofs & Dispute Game Updates
*   **ZK Challenge Support in `op-challenger`:** The `op-challenger move --attack` command now supports Zero-Knowledge (ZK) challenges, detecting the on-chain game type and calling the appropriate ZK game bindings. ([#22575](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22575))
*   **Dispute Game Config Validation:** The `OPContractsManagerMigrator.migrate()` function now validates dispute game configurations, preventing the registration of invalid or `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` games. ([#22441](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22441))
*   **Kona SP1 Proposer CPU Prover Avoidance:** The `kona-sp1-proposer` now avoids using `CpuProver` in network mode, replacing it with `LightProver` when setting SP1 keys for network proofs. ([#22588](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22588))
*   **Pinning Proposer Sync Reads to L1 Block Hash:** The `kona-sp1` proposer now preserves the selected L1 header hash in `L1BlockRef` and uses it for all block-pinned proposer sync reads, addressing a previous issue where claim data fetched was not anchored to a blockhash. ([#22549](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22549))

*   [#22585](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22585) `op-node`: publish gossiped blocks off the sequencer's hot path
*   [#22581](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22581) `CODEOWNERS`, `public-docs`: add `monorepo-reviewers` as co-owner of public docs
*   [#22580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22580) `claude`: add opt-in `watch-reviews` skill with org-member trust boundary
*   [#22578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22578) `docs`, `agents`: add the `interop-reviewer` agent and its review guide
*   [#22577](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22577) `docs`, `agents`: add the `deletion-reviewer` agent and its review guide
*   [#22576](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22576) `kona-engine`: local/cross-safe vocabulary and a single cross-safe promotion entry point

*   [#22567](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22567) `kona-node-service`: support multiple chains in the L1 watcher
*   [#22566](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22566) `op-reth`: use the engine's sparse trie pipeline on the payload build path
*   [#22565](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22565) `kona-interop`: consolidate message validity rules
*   [#22562](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22562) `kona-sp1`: build shared scenario world
*   [#22560](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22560) `ci`, `rust`: rebalance `rust-cargo-hack` with weighted package partitioning
*   [#22558](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22558) `op-node`: tolerate pruned L1 history in genesis check (including reth --minimal)
*   [#22557](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22557) `kona-engine`: skip unsafe-head staleness check for seals atomic with their build
*   [#22556](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22556) `docs`: add `node101` to OP Stack RPC directory
*   [#22553](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22553) `kona-node`: prefer raw L1 receipt fetching
*   [#22552](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22552) `kona!`: remove `op-supervisor-era` interop legacy

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Interoperability and Node Refactoring
*   The issue of removing the `cross-unsafe` chain-head notion from Go components (`op-node`, `op-service`, `op-devstack`) has been closed. This change streamlines the interop design by eliminating a vestigial concept from the `op-supervisor` era. ([#22550](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22550))

### Kona SafeDB Implementation
*   The `kona-node` SafeDB issue has been closed, indicating the successful porting of the `op-node`'s `safedb` package to Rust. This new `kona-safedb` crate is crucial for tracking L2 safe heads per L1 block for fault proofs and interop. ([#20278](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20278))

### Proposer Data Anchoring
*   The issue concerning the proposer claiming data fetched not being anchored to a blockhash has been resolved. This ensures that the proposer's sync reads are consistently pinned to a specific L1 block hash. ([#18411](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18411))
